About the Fellowship The Fellowship in Internal Medicine is a 12-month, fully online advanced fellowship program for doctors who want to build comprehensive knowledge in adult medicine. Internal medicine focuses on the evaluation, diagnosis, and medical management of adult patients across a wide range of conditions. This program covers symptom-based assessment, investigation interpretation, cardiology, respiratory medicine, gastroenterology, nephrology, endocrinology, infectious diseases, neurology, rheumatology, geriatrics, medical emergencies, preventive medicine, rational prescribing, and patient communication. The curriculum is designed to help doctors improve their academic understanding of internal medicine and apply a broader, more organised approach to adult patient care.
